adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse()` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`{ success, data, error }`), not the parsed `data` itself. In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result is assigned to `key` and persisted via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, which would store the wrapper object instead of the credential payload. This would corrupt the stored credential shape (e.g., later code expecting `credential.key.access_token` would not find it at the top level).
